schema_family: claude-root-worker-seam-design (v1 ... v6 key sets retained where still meaningful; v7 adds material_names, capacity_rule, json_modes, held_identity, cause_operand, unknown_routes, front_phase_after_abort, release_hold_scope, relay_wait, frame_order, factory_fork_point, h_prime.d_h7, h_prime.policy_fields, rc_rename, sweep)
author: Claude Code lead claude-opus-5-5 (drafting subagent, author role)

acceptance.review: An independent review of v7 is required. The author grants nothing.

design_document.relation: v7 is this file plus the carried v6 slices with R7-1 ... R7-86 applied, and transitively everything those slices carry (the v5, v4, v3, v2 and v1 chains with their R-blocks, minus W5-1 and W5-2)

companions.hash_cycle: SEAM-DESIGN.md Appendix D binds jackal.json and AUTHOR-NOTES.md; this file binds SEAM-DESIGN.md; the handback binds this file

answers.V6-REQ-L: V7-L; SEAM-DESIGN.md section A.3, A.4, C.2, C.5 and Appendix B

self_containment.rule: Each slice's sha256 is that of the UTF-8 bytes of its v6 lines, each followed by a newline.
self_containment.normative_bindings: every identity a normative statement relies on is in SEAM-DESIGN.md Appendix B; ruling owners and evidence in section A.3; aliases in section C.2

material_names.m: SHA-256 of the whole material only

decide_v2_roster: V1 PARAMETERS in order, then FactsV2, then Selection, immediately before Output; serialized without Output
capacity_rule: output arena C = F * (M + 1): F span fields in the allowed output rows, M the largest input span length; successors of generation, Reattach_Epoch and sub-generations covered (JACKAL J7-1, J7-2)

CG-2.basis: worker-served IP handlers run under the root-worker plan's worker_policy admitted under the WL request's reservation

CG-3.basis: later WL requests queued for g+1

dispatcher.oom_path: resource_telemetry oomKilled and hitMemoryCeiling from the leaf memory.events

json_modes.cj_json: per mode: Ready for every input the site's Python check accepts

held_identity.init_start_tick: read while holding the HELD-frame init pidfd, fdinfo Pid pairing, liveness poll after the read

custody_return_evidence.R1: worker and namespace-init pidfds terminal (K-24) plus OB-ESC
custody_return_evidence.R2: identities gone (boot identity, ESRCH, start tick, or init_exited_at_held) plus fresh exclusive flock on every transferred lock plus OB-ESC

cause_operand: EvidenceRec kind Cause_Record whose sha256 equals unknown_cause; no RootStateRec field or column added

unknown_routes.C-CHANNEL: WORKER_REATTACHED after UNKNOWN, worker live, to Before_Unknown
unknown_routes.C-APPEND: verified chain, to Before_Unknown; replay hit or Legal re-append

front_phase_after_abort.owners_closed: HANDOFF_ABORTED plus reconstruction task in front.collectors

release_hold_scope: Held_Capacity only; Irreversible_Budget root rows keep their state
frame_order: out_seq per (g, r, s) over PROGRESS_BYTES and RESPONSE_BYTES, written in order
re_derivation: custody owner runs rw/daemon.py:318-332 over the recorded line bytes

h_prime.d_h7: request-root launch while the coordinator owns custody: launch_reserved's steps, with LAUNCH_REQUEST_ROOT executed by the coordinator's root helper
non_field_differences: agents nested in the request root (CJ-H-5)
D-H2 decision mode without admission fields
h_prime.who_decides: lead only after CJ-H-1, CJ-H-2 and CJ-H-5 are shown with every field unchanged; otherwise D-4a's existing reservation (OP-3); not adopted

measurements.K-29: boot_id constant within a boot, different after reboot (OP-7)

sweep.remaining_hits: all in kept classes (SEAM-DESIGN.md Appendix C)

controls.retained: every original and additive control; none retired
controls.added: SEAM-DESIGN.md V7-N; V7-N.K outside the roster unless H-prime is adopted

process.writes: Write and Edit only, only in WT/designs/claude-root-worker-seam-design-v7/
process.bash: read-only inspection, with the deviations of AUTHOR-NOTES section 5
process.sia: no call in the v7 task; no note

open: V5-REQ-A, C, D, E, F, G, I, J, K
non_claims: Nothing is reviewed, accepted, proved or authorized; no approval gate is added.
Nothing was compiled, run, imported, proved, tested or measured.
No equivalence for the dispatcher's persisted evidence texts, worker-served IP, later WL requests, or H-prime's nesting.
Pairing and boot identity rest on K-4 and K-29; PEER_LOST_WITH_FRONT on K-6.
JSON refusal tables are the author's reading until RC-5.
